warnings: A before/after comparison does not establish causation. Independent clinicians and approximately normal paired differences are assumed. Repeated encounters must first be aggregated per clinician using a predefined rule.
SIMULATED DATA: these results demonstrate the method and are not clinical evidence.
summary.report: Simulated paired data from 5000 clinicians were analyzed. Mean pre-intervention and post-intervention values were 5.100 and 4.153 minutes, respectively. The mean paired difference (pre minus post) was 0.948 minutes. The 95% confidence interval was [0.930, 0.966]; two-sided paired t(4999) = 103.544, p below numerical precision; Cohen dz = 1.464. These results do not establish causality or changes in burnout, patient engagement, or clinical safety.
